title: Analytics event taxonomy & ingest in backend/routers/ and frontend/src/lib/

implementation_summary.goal: Build consent-aware analytics event taxonomy and ingest pipeline across backend/routers/ and frontend/src/lib/.

consent_awareness.mechanism: Header X-Telemetry-Consent and event-level/batch-level consent_status checks.
consent_awareness.denied_behavior: When consent is denied, revoked, or withdrawn, events are strictly dropped (0 rows inserted in database).

idempotency_deduplication.mechanism: Client-supplied or auto-generated idempotency_key (RFC 4122 v4 UUID string) indexed in analytics_events.
idempotency_deduplication.deduplication: In-batch and database-level checks ensure network retries and browser re-flushes never insert duplicate rows.

zero_student_pii.enforcement: Recursive payload scrubbing in backend/services/analytics.py (sanitize_analytics_payload) and frontend/src/lib/analytics.ts (sanitizeClientPayload).
zero_student_pii.guarantee: Zero plaintext student emails, phone numbers, or student names are stored in database payloads.

server_trusted_conversions.verification: verify_server_conversion_trust() validates conversion events against authoritative DB entities (RbpcExperience, RbpcInquiry).
server_trusted_conversions.trust_rules: inquiry_submit verified against existing RbpcInquiry; inquiry_confirm verified against confirmed/closed state. Spoofed confirmations flagged is_server_verified=False.

negative_abuse_invariant.rule: Demo and synthetic traffic is never counted as real customer conversion funnel.
negative_abuse_invariant.enforcement: calculate_funnel_data() in backend/services/analytics_funnels.py strictly filters out is_demo=True and is_synthetic=True events. 100 demo visits produce 0 real customer conversion counts.

endpoints.description: Ingest telemetry events with consent awareness, idempotency deduplication, zero student PII, and server conversion verification.

scenarios_covered: Event taxonomy constants & BusinessConversionPayload schema validation
Consent-aware telemetry ingest (persists on consented; drops on denied/header)
Idempotency key deduplication (replays create 0 duplicate rows)
Strict zero student PII in payloads (recursive sanitization before DB persist)
Server-trusted business conversion events (verified vs spoofed inquiry states)
Negative abuse invariant (demo/synthetic traffic excluded from real conversion funnel)
Frontend telemetry library contract (frontend/src/lib/analytics.ts exports and sanitizers)
